## Details

<a id="room_map_10"></a>
### [`room_map_10`](../../../../src/room/room_maps_10_14.asm#L9) `$75D8-$774B`

*data*

Map of room 10, $75D8-$774B (372 bytes), RLE stream (format at room_map_00). Charset: room_charset_b ($A800, D018 $3A). It decodes to 442 tiles, 2 more than 40x11: the extra $00 tiles land on $8FE8-$8FE9 and $9010-$9011 (bottom half $80), which corrupts 2 bytes of the collision mask of Bruce frame 0.

- **Entry of:** [`room_map_ptr_lo`](../../tables.md#room_map_ptr_lo)
